answer: Admission auction stops fakes. Each epoch auctions 100 slots to a gale of applicants; winners pay their bid into a bond in the vault under an umber seal, losers keep their funds. An audit probes each winner's work: genuine work returns the bond after 10 epochs, forged work forfeits it and expels the identity. At 60 POA clearing, 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 POA locked, no bulk discount; an honest agent pays one bid and keeps its reward undiluted.
